description.en-US: The 1948 English selection of two hundred and forty-three letters and the shorter works of John Eudes (the Memoriale, the Vow, the Contract with the Virgin, the Letter to the Virgin, the Testament), translated by Ruth Hauser.
description.pt-BR: A seleção inglesa de 1948 de duzentas e quarenta e três cartas e das obras menores de João Eudes, em tradução de Ruth Hauser.

sources.edition: Letters and Shorter Works, translated by Ruth Hauser, New York, P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1948. Text layer of the Bibliothèque Saint Libère PDF (liberius.net), from the Eudist Fathers series, 1946–48.
sources.description: Converted by script: running heads and page numbers removed, paragraphs rejoined, hyphenation repaired. The OCR of the PDF text layer leaves some residual errors (for example 0 for O, rn for m); the translator’s introduction and notes are kept. The translation is not aligned chapter by chapter to the French edition, so it is a separate book.
sources.tierEvidence: Copyright 1946–48 P. J. Kenedy & Sons; no renewal in the Copyright Office records 1950–2001.
